Guide conjugation details: Fill in the verb forms for the displayed persons and confirm with OK or Enter. Missing forms are disabled. Incorrect answers reveal the expected forms; confirming them continues without counting a new success. Next verb skips the current verb. Ctrl+R opens the previous verb. Save commits changes and returns to the menu. Close offers to save unsaved changes.
Guide courses: Build your own courses. Filter and paste words, record pronunciation and enter word classes manually.
Guide editor details: Create and edit courses in the table. Paste multiple words, filter by column and delete selected words. Other IDs stay unchanged. Enter word classes manually; add descriptions, examples and pronunciation. Save commits changes and returns to the menu. Close offers to save unsaved changes.
Guide grammar details: Choose one of four answers. After answering or selecting Show answer, the correct option and explanation appear. Next continues; Enter continues after feedback, and Space reveals or advances. The session tracks correct answers, mistakes and streaks. Submitted answers are saved as you go; revealing alone does not write an answer to the history.
Guide practice: Practice with translations, context or audio. Your answers determine the next review date.
Guide progress: Explore vocabulary growth, review forecasts and results for vocabulary, conjugation and grammar.
Guide repeat details: Review due words by typing a translation, completing a context question or choosing an answer after listening. Letter hints help with spelling. Feedback shows the correct word and its details; the previous-word review separates translation, pronunciation, description and example. Results determine the next review date. Save stores your progress; task probabilities and batch size are set in preferences.
Guide services: Dictionary details and audio can be fetched when saving. Set provider keys in preferences.
Guide services details: When saving a course, missing dictionary details and automatic audio can be requested from the configured providers. Add the necessary API keys in preferences; these features need an internet connection. Word classes remain manual. You can use your own recordings instead of automatic audio and keep manually entered descriptions and examples.
Guide statistics details: View vocabulary growth, review forecasts and results for vocabulary, grammar and conjugation. Success rings summarize the results of each learning module. The statistics table supports text filtering, sorting by column and paging through results. Switch the course language at the top without leaving the window.
Guide storage: Courses are stored locally. Email backups are configured in preferences; audio files are not included.
Guide storage details: Courses and learning histories are stored in local CSV files. Audio is stored separately. Configure the email backup interval and mail settings in preferences; email backups do not include audio recordings. Save edits or the active repetition session before leaving to keep the latest changes.
